steps.name: Precondition — create a dedicated disposable agent
Step 1 — Navigate to the agent detail page
Step 2 — Add starters "How do I create a new agent?" and "What toolkits are available?" via press_sequentially
Step 4 — Open a new chat session with this agent (full-navigation reload for a pristine, freshly-mounted embedded chat panel)
Step 5 — Verify both starter chips are visible in the chat panel before any message is sent
Step 6 — Click the 'How do I create a new agent?' starter chip
Step 7 — Verify the starter text is submitted as a pre-filled value in the input (pre-fill only — no auto-send, chip row disappears immediately)
Step 8 — Send the pre-filled message and verify the agent responds
